scientific_question: Can a coordinate-comparable persistent functional metric rank recurrent-state INT8 rotations in the same direction as held-out reasoning quality?

primary_aime_panel.name: clean59
primary_aime_panel.rule: Exclude the single paired trajectory with pre-existing non-finite audit findings from both rotations; exclusion is based only on numerical validity.

metric_definitions.raw_m0: Existing canonical-basis recovered recurrent-state Frobenius error.
metric_definitions.raw_m5: Existing frozen linearized functional error ||W_O D_g D_w J_RMS(o) E^T q||_2 using canonical/recovered state error and FP operators.
metric_definitions.decision: Existing |delta logit on FP winner| / max(FP top1-top2 margin, 1e-6).
metric_definitions.m0_relative: M0 divided by the FP recurrent-state norm, using the existing capture definition.
metric_definitions.teacher_forced_kl: Exact full-vocabulary KL(FP || INT8) at the same teacher-forced history; unavailable unless full logits exist.
metric_definitions.delta_nll: -log p_INT8(reference next token) + log p_FP(reference next token); unavailable unless logits or log probabilities exist.
metric_definitions.delta_margin: FP-selected-token margin in FP minus the same token margin in INT8; unavailable unless logits exist.
metric_definitions.persistent_metric: Anchor-reset teacher-forced future KL/delta-NLL/delta-margin at H={1,4,8,16,32,64}; an AIME value requires a saved restartable FP cache/state or a newly specified replay protocol.
metric_definitions.external_qwen_persistent_kl: Existing exact full-vocabulary Future-KL on a fixed 64-document non-AIME held-out panel at H={1,4,8,16,32,64,128}; used only for cross-rotation direction and h=1 versus multi-horizon diagnostics.

horizons.auc_weights: equal weight across H={1,4,8,16,32,64}; H=128 is excluded from the preregistered primary equal-weight AUC

trajectory_aggregation.mean: arithmetic mean over finite valid observations
trajectory_aggregation.p95: linear 95th percentile over finite valid observations
trajectory_aggregation.cvar95: mean of observations greater than or equal to the trajectory p95
trajectory_aggregation.nonfinite: reported explicitly; the clean59 primary panel excludes the sole affected pair symmetrically

candidate_aggregation.primary: median across clean59 trajectory-level p95 values
candidate_aggregation.secondary: median across clean59 trajectory means and CVaR95 values; external 64-document persistent-KL uses the pre-existing mean per-document equal-horizon AUC
candidate_aggregation.direction: lower is better for all risk metrics

tail_localization.primary_observation: per-token m5_layer_p95 from the existing capture

status_rule.EXTREME: top 0.1% contributes at least 25% of total mass OR top 1% contributes at least 50%
status_rule.MODERATE: otherwise, top 1% contributes at least 20% OR top 5% contributes at least 50%

rescue_analysis.delta: Hadamard minus Identity; negative means improvement for lower-is-better metrics.
statistics: rescue versus stable-failure permutation test on median delta with 10000 permutations

cross_rotation_rule: PAIRWISE_DIRECTION_CHECK only: a lower-is-better candidate aggregate is CORRECT iff Hadamard < Identity while 41/59 > 18/59.
promising_surrogate_requirements: more favorable rescue association than stable-failure
no post-hoc layer, horizon, or threshold selection

artifact_sufficiency_policy.forbidden_substitution: Do not relabel local M5, shifted token metrics, approximate KL, or the non-AIME panel as AIME anchor-reset persistent metrics.

deterministic_replay.local_replay: Replay every trajectory once from the original prompt; prefill is unquantized, then recurrent-state C128 QDQ is applied after every teacher-forced generated token exactly as in the prior mechanism capture. Compute full-vocabulary KL, delta-NLL, and FP-token margin degradation online without saving logits.

persistent_anchor_rule.formula: For N generated tokens and maximum horizon 64, anchor=floor(f*(N-65)) for each frozen fraction f; deduplicate anchors while preserving order.
persistent_anchor_rule.prefix: Rebuild the exact FP-equivalent batch cache from prompt plus generated_token_ids[:anchor] with quantization disabled.
persistent_anchor_rule.intervention: At the anchor, quantize only recurrent states for Identity and Hadamard rows in their native/rotated coordinates, then apply the same QDQ after every future teacher-forced token.
persistent_anchor_rule.horizon_observation: After processing the token at anchor+h-1, compare logits predicting generated_token_ids[anchor+h].
